text: Giorgi Sharashidze - What talk is there of a Vice-Premiership or a State Ministry? They aren't even giving him a proper office; he won't have a staff or a secretary. I would advise Mdinaradze not to get too fixated on this office and to work remotely (28.04.2026, 12:04)

"What talk is there of a Vice-Premiership or a State Minister post? They aren't even giving Mdinaradze a proper office; he won't have a staff or even a secretary. I would advise him not to get too fixated on this office and to work remotely from home," stated Giorgi Sharashidze, an MP from the "Gakharia for Georgia" party, while discussing the creation of the post of State Minister for the coordination of law enforcement agencies. According to him, the appointment of a general-coordinator will change nothing except that it will be his "temporary satisfaction and a way to send him into retirement."

"The planned changes have nothing to do with solving the problems of our country's citizens or Georgia's security issues. This is another manifestation of informal governance. 'Dream' and the 89 deputies sitting in parliament have no role other than to simply 'legitimize' Ivanishvili's decisions, which no one coordinates with them. What talk is there of a vice-premiership or a state ministry; they aren't even giving him a proper office, and Mdinaradze won't even have a staff or a secretary. I would advise him not to be too fixated on this office and to work remotely from home instead."

If coordination is so important—the head of the State Security Service is not removed in six months for the sake of coordination. The head of the State Security Service is not appointed for a six-year term by chance—this provision in the law is not accidental. We see that in the last year, two heads of the State Security Service have already been replaced. This indicates an unstable environment and informal governance. A person was granted the rank of general in the morning and demoted to a coordinator in the evening of the same day—what special expectations should we have of this person?

"As for the role of coordinator—'Dream' itself introduced this term, and yesterday, when one of our leaders, Giga Parulava, stated the fact at the Legal Affairs Committee meeting that you are appointing [him] as a coordinator, it caused such irritation that they criticized his vocabulary and tone. This 'coordinator' is a term introduced by 'Dream,' and if it is offensive to them, then let them explain where they even got this term from. Therefore, when we say that the appointment of this general-coordinator will change nothing except that it will simply be a way to temporarily satisfy him and send him into retirement, this is the reality," Sharashidze stated.

For information, the Parliament is considering a bill through an expedited procedure, based on which the position of State Minister for the Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies is being introduced within the Government of Georgia.
According to the project, the Government Administration will provide material-technical and organizational support for the activities of the new State Minister.

According to the Parliamentary Secretary of the Government, Vakhtang Bachiashvili, the powers of the State Minister will be specified in a government decree, where his routine or strategic powers will be defined.
Mamuka Mdinaradze will be appointed to the position of State Minister for Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies.
